testsuite.name: com.zynergylabs.forager.app.ui.log.PhotoViewerSaveToFolderTest

testcase.name: cancelling the picker shows no message
a tap opens the create-document picker with the sniffed type and name, and writes nothing to MediaStore
a document that cannot be written shows the failure message and is logged
the chosen document receives the stored bytes and Saved shows
